tasks.short: Prepare proposals, quotes and contracts for solar customers.

steps.what: Collect site, tariff and product choices for the quote.
Price the quote from the product and tariff rules.
Draft proposals and quotes for potential solar customers.

loop.input: Priced lines and the site record
loop.output: A proposal that states only those prices and the named system
loop.check: Representative checks every price and every saving against the priced lines
loop.stop: One draft; a price that is not in the priced lines is deleted
loop.why_not_simpler: The narrative follows this roof and this tariff, not one stored page

steps.what: Check price, savings and the contract terms.
Send the checked proposal to the customer.

tasks.design: The {ERP} prices the quote from the product list and the tariff, including the feed-in rule. A draft proposal may use only those prices. The representative checks the saving and the contract, and only that version is sent. Native price configuration is tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: Quotes were rebuilt in a sheet for every roof, and the tariff was typed again each time.
tasks.enabler_now: A price list and a tariff rule can price a standard system. The words for this customer, and any nonstandard roof, still need the representative.
tasks.still_hard: Roofs that are not in the product rules, and tariffs the price list does not hold.
tasks.human_edge: The representative knows when a saving would mislead this household.

ambition.what: The representative decides the same day whether a quote is standard enough to send, instead of rebuilding the price from scratch.

tasks.altitude: Quote checks stay on the week. The representative can refuse to send a saving the tariff rule did not produce.

reach.task: Prepare a priced proposal from a tariff
reach.learn: Which figures they refuse to send until the tariff version is named

evidence.claim: A configurator linked to the customer and finance systems can fill a quote from product rules, and a person checks the result.
Net metering ends on 1 January 2027. Until 2030 the feed-in fee must be at least half of the bare supply tariff, so a savings figure has to use that rule.

assumptions: Focal role is the solar sales representative. Boundary: from site, tariff and product choice to a sent proposal. The site visit and the customer's decision are other tasks.

Structured fields are system code, quantities, tariff code and feed-in rate. The price list produces the unit prices. The representative produces any exception. Fallback: a missing price is typed, not guessed, and blocks the send.
Test native pricing in the {ERP} before custom code. A customer-facing chat is not used to quote.
Upkeep of 5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers price lists and the feed-in rule.
unknowns: Whether the price list already includes the post-2027 feed-in rule.
What share of quotes uses a standard system.
research_questions: What share of proposals is a nonstandard roof or a one-off contract clause?

already_counted.description: Edit the proposal against the priced lines

incremental.description: Update price lists and the feed-in rule when tariffs change

approvals.approved_version: proposal version whose prices match the tariff run

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the roof or the tariff is outside the price list, so the quote is still built by hand and the check is the whole task. High: a standard system prices itself and the representative only checks the saving and the contract. The check is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select solar products and systems for a customer's site.

steps.what: Review the customer's electrical requirements and site conditions.
List solar products and systems that fit the energy rules.
Select solar products, systems or services for the customer.
Talk the shortlist and the price through with customers.

tasks.design: Catalogue rules in the {ERP} list systems that fit the load and the site fields. The representative still selects what to offer and talks it through with the customer. Native catalogue configuration is tested before custom code. The final choice is not a model.
tasks.previous_blocker: The representative compared brochures and a sheet for every house.
tasks.enabler_now: A catalogue can drop systems the site cannot use. Choosing among the rest is the job.
tasks.still_hard: Sites with shade, odd roofs, or a load the customer cannot describe.
tasks.human_edge: The representative hears which compromise the household will actually live with.

ambition.what: The representative decides at the visit which catalogue systems are worth offering, instead of pricing every brochure.

tasks.altitude: Selection conversations stay on the week. The representative can refuse a system the site fields do not support.

reach.task: Choose which property to show a buyer
reach.learn: How they drop options that do not fit before the meeting

evidence.claim: A configurator can narrow product choice from site and catalogue rules. The final choice stays with a person.

assumptions: Focal role is the solar sales representative. Boundary: from load and site conditions to a system the customer has discussed. Signing the quote is a different task.

Structured fields are annual load, roof type, budget and catalogue codes. The customer states the load. The catalogue owner maintains the rules. Fallback: if load or roof is missing, no shortlist is produced.
Test native catalogue rules before custom code.
Upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers catalogue rules when products change.
unknowns: Whether electrical load is measured or only estimated by the customer.
research_questions: What share of customers accepts the first shortlisted system?

incremental.description: Update catalogue rules when products are added or withdrawn

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: load and roof are too thin for the rules, so the representative still compares systems by hand, and the conversation is unchanged. High: the shortlist is usable and only the choice and the talk remain. The choice is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Answer customers on quotes, orders, warranties, funding and rebates.

steps.what: Look up orders, shipping, warranties and credit.
Provide stock and sales information the record already states.
Explain funding options, incentives and rebates.
Draft the quotes the customers asked to see in writing.

loop.input: The record lines and the published rebate rule
loop.output: A written answer that quotes only those lines
loop.check: Representative checks every price, warranty and rebate figure
loop.stop: One draft; a figure that is not in the record or the rule is deleted
loop.why_not_simpler: Customers ask in sentences, and a wrong price can bind the seller

steps.what: Check any price, warranty or rebate figure.

tasks.design: Stock, shipping and warranty status are read from the {ERP}. Funding, incentives and rebates are explained by the representative. A written price or warranty is drafted only from the record and the published rule, checked, and then sent. No credit decision is automated. Native record views are tested first.
tasks.previous_blocker: The representative looked up each fact and retyped it into mail, including prices.
tasks.enabler_now: The order record can answer stock and shipping. A price, a warranty or a rebate in writing can bind the seller if it is wrong.
tasks.still_hard: Questions the manual does not cover, and rebate rules that changed this month.
tasks.human_edge: The representative knows when the honest answer is that the record does not say.
tasks.altitude: Explanations stay on the week. The representative can refuse to send a figure the record does not hold.

reach.task: Explain a price, a term and what is not covered
reach.learn: Which sentences they will not put in writing without the source line

evidence.claim: An answer screen can read stock, price, order and warranty fields. Questions outside the record stay with a person.
A written price or warranty can bind the seller if it is wrong. An automated credit check for consumer solar finance would be high-risk from 2 December 2027, and this design does not make one.

assumptions: Focal role is the solar sales representative. Boundary: from a customer question to a spoken answer or a checked written answer. Granting credit is out of scope.
Structured fields are order number, stock, ship date, warranty code and published rebate rate. The finance system produces them. Fallback: a missing field is said to be unknown, not filled.
Test native {ERP} views before custom code. There is no customer-facing chat quoting prices.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers rebate rates.
unknowns: Which rebate rules are stable enough to store.
Whether warranty text is a field or a PDF.
research_questions: What share of questions is answered by a field already on the order?

incremental.description: Update published rebate and warranty texts

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: most questions are outside the record, so the representative still researches them, and every written price is typed. High: stock and shipping come from the record and only the explanation and the figure check remain. The check is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Gather solar needs from prospective customers.

steps.what: Gather information on prospective customers' solar energy needs.
Enter the answers in the lead fields.

loop.input: The representative's notes from the conversation
loop.output: Lead fields for use, roof and budget, blank where the note is silent
loop.check: Representative checks each field against the note
loop.stop: One pass; a silent field stays empty
loop.why_not_simpler: Customers speak in sentences, not in the lead form

steps.what: Flag facts a later quote cannot run without.
Ask the customer for those missing facts.

tasks.design: The representative still meets the customer and asks about use, roof and budget. Notes fill the lead fields, and empty required fields are listed for a follow-up. Native lead fields are tested before custom code. The meeting is not replaced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Needs were written in a notebook and typed into the customer record later, often incomplete.
tasks.enabler_now: Required fields can show what is missing. The conversation that produces them stays.
tasks.still_hard: Customers who do not know their use or their roof, and visits that are really a sale already.
tasks.human_edge: The representative hears what the household is actually trying to solve.
tasks.altitude: First meetings stay on the week. The representative can refuse to open a quote while a required fact is empty.

reach.task: Ask what a traveller needs before offering a trip
reach.learn: Which facts they insist on before they will quote

evidence.claim: A lead form can hold use, roof and budget. Gathering those facts in conversation stays with the representative.

assumptions: Focal role is the solar sales representative. Boundary: from the first conversation to a lead record with gaps flagged. Quoting is a different task.
Structured fields are annual use, roof type, budget and contact. The customer supplies them. Fallback: the representative types any field the note left blank.
Test native {CRM} lead fields before custom code. Consumer calls still follow the opt-in rule on the prospecting task.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers required fields.
unknowns: Whether first conversations are at home, on the phone, or both.
Which fields the quote actually requires.
research_questions: What share of first meetings already has a bill or a roof photo?

already_counted.description: Check lead fields against the notes

incremental.description: Adjust required lead fields when the quote rules change

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the meeting is the whole task and notes stay messy, so little is saved. High: the form shows the gaps and only the conversation remains. The meeting is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still site visits, demonstrations and customer conversations. Quotes and yield figures are calculated before the meeting. The representative can refuse to send a price or a saving the tariff rule did not produce.
reach: Insurance sales agents: which funding question needs a licensed credit conversation
Real estate sales agents: how a visit is written down before a price is discussed
skills_to_grow: Checking a yield figure against shading the model missed
Keeping consumer calls inside the opt-in list
Reading a drawing against a measurement
role.ambitious_version: Every quote starts from a tariff rule the representative will sign, and no consumer is called without an opt-in.
